AGCO Corporation develops innovative agricultural machinery and digital solutions that support farmers and sustainable agriculture. The Software Engineer will design distributed and real-time software systems, develop semi-autonomous agricultural products, author software requirements, and integrate and deploy software to test vehicles in an Agile environment.

Continuously Integrate and Deploy software to test vehicles
